spec_match.rationale: The reference content (attribute values, element support, related attributes, TSF background) is broadly consistent with the autocorrect attribute spec, but none of it is anchored to a live read of the engine — notably the reflected IDL claim, which is measurably absent on some engines (probed false on Chromium 141).

interactive.rationale: Three tables and a snippet, no controls. The attribute is trivially probeable ('autocorrect' in HTMLElement.prototype, reflection round-trip) and the page probes nothing.

blurb_alignment.rationale: 'Everything about the autocorrect HTML attribute' — as a static reference it can silently drift from the engine truth it describes.

edge_cases.rationale: No engine-support handling: on browsers without the reflected IDL (measured here) the reference's IDL statements are wrong for the reader's own browser with no disclosure.

references.rationale: Feature index links chromestatus; the reference tables cite no spec anchors.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite exists; page anchors nothing to it.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run: 'autocorrect' in HTMLElement.prototype = false (attribute-only on this engine) — exactly the kind of engine-truth the page should surface; rendering clean, 0px overflow both classes, zero console errors.

design_system.rationale: Standard tables and stone blocks with CSS variables.

accessibility.rationale: Real tables with headers; prose sections labelled.

openQuestions.title: Anchor the reference to live probes
openQuestions.detail: Add a small live panel: 'autocorrect' in HTMLElement.prototype, a reflection round-trip (set attribute, read IDL and back), and per-element support checks driving the element-support table's rows from the visitor's own engine (measured here: IDL absent on Chromium 141 — the current table would mislead that reader).

guidanceConsulted.query: attribute reference page live reflection probes
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Derive reference claims from the runtime where possible.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: NOT applied — filed as the major question, with this critique's probe supplying the first measurement.

summary: Reviewed headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): a tidy but entirely static reference whose IDL claims are already untrue on the probed engine ('autocorrect' not in HTMLElement.prototype on 141) with no disclosure; layout is clean on both classes. Major live-probe question filed.
